host_operation.name: export_cloud_data
host_operation.principal: actual authorized Project exporter, cloud read scope and caller-owned SelectedFileRef purpose export_cloud_data
host_operation.input: revision, immutable DaaS query(page.cursor=null,limit=200), selected fixed result and actual directory selection; no caller path/URL/token/rows
host_operation.effects: Host Task registration + authorized cloud read + new local directory; no production/Engine/cloud write
host_operation.lookup: H09 original request index adds fourth registered branch; same id same params returns original task, different params conflict
host_operation.shared_handle: H10/H11 both exporting; rename design-only ExecutionReportTaskHandle to ExportingTaskHandle, use one HostOkData handle branch rather than duplicate identical oneOf members
host_operation.task: LongTaskKind.Exporting; TaskOutput.CloudDataExport; same get_task ownership, request/context and managed response checks

selection.ui: button captures actual displayed query and first selection. No valid result -> query first. Current input changes invalidate displayed export selection; selected old result never relabelled as new filter
selection.telemetry: pin cloud_project/dataset/F/selected_device_ids from actual first result; original source may be empty or final page. Directory frontier does not substitute for this selection
selection.device_membership: C08 each telemetry page returns selected_device_ids. [] resolves sorted authorized device refs present at fixed F; explicit authorized ids retained even without rows. Cursor carries resolved typed ids; changed authorization producing different membership conflicts rather than silently changing grouping
selection.replay: export query canonical limit200/cursor=null; use selected explicit device ids; if pinned selected ids empty, query must still return same empty resolved set or fail. Pins never grant authorization
selection.start_cursor: raw telemetry: same fixed F and normalized query, after_ingress_id=0. Minute aggregate: same fixed F/query, after_row_index=null means before first index0; later cursors numeric. Client cannot treat null as last index0
selection.execution: query selection must be exact revision equal pinned execution revision/identity; C08 first cursor=null reads that immutable snapshot. No second latest/cutoff resolution during export
selection.scope: each page actual authorization and dataset/F/device-set or execution identity/revision match; wrong row kind, repeated/nonprogress page or missing page fails export
selection.page_boundary: page limit200; last next_cursor=null; exports from canonical beginning through final page; original UI page size/position are not a result-row filter
selection.descriptor: telemetry reads actual scoped C12 descriptor for same dataset/purpose/source_mode, stored in header/receipt; descriptor frontier is discovery metadata, not exported F. Execution projection descriptor=null, no guessed physical/source mode

streaming.directory: new cloud-data-<export_id> child of actual selected directory; existing name conflicts, no overwrite
streaming.work: one current typed page plus buffered writers and counters; network/file IO outside Host mutex; no all-row Vec, PDF producer, ProjectArchive or browser download
streaming.jsonl: UTF-8 one JSON value per line: exactly1 header, >=1 page records with1-based contiguous page_index, exactly1 footer complete=true. Every page contains original DaaSQueryResult including quality issues and selection; no loss of page issues
streaming.csv: one header chosen by query kind; one row per original typed query row in original order; export_row_index starts0; UTF-8 and ordinary CSV quoting
streaming.csv_cell_encoding: json_value: every data cell is complete JSON text for its typed value, then CSV-escaped; strings include JSON quotes, nested row remains JSON object, null is literal null. Independent reader uses csv then json.loads per cell; no float conversion or silent empty-to-zero
streaming.footer: row_count=sum actual page rows; page_count includes empty terminal result; quality_issue_occurrence_count=sum issues over pages (not unique issue count)
streaming.empty: still write CSV header and JSONL header/one empty page/footer row_count0, preserving selection and issues
streaming.independent_clients: authorized clients may stream C08 themselves; H11 is desktop/Agent selected-file delivery, not a new public cloud download endpoint

csv.common_rule: metadata is in JSONL header; CSV keys below are concrete per-query columns and json_value cells
csv.telemetry_row_sources: TelemetryRow -> observation.device_id/device_sequence; GeneratedLoadRow -> event.device_ref/device_sequence; source_mode comes from actual authorized C12 DatasetDescriptor, never guessed from telemetry purpose; payload_json preserves whole typed row
csv.exact_fields: Quantity uses quantity.value.coefficient/decimal_places and quantity.unit; source_row_index is original row.row_index, never export index or dataset ingress; UTC fields preserve original microsecond string

publication.existing_source: project_store.rs:1529 write_evaluation_directory stages then MoveFileW, refuses existing destination; currently takes in-memory files and ProjectArchive
publication.needed_change: L22 add data-specific fixed two-file staging handles and non-overwriting commit using existing Directory primitives/Windows rename semantics; old evaluation function not used as a million-row memory wrapper
publication.commit: write all pages, footer, flush and close handles; apply original Task/caller/selection rules, check cancellation immediately before directory publication; rename is commit point
publication.cancel_before: cancel only export, no final directory/FileRef success; original hidden stage may remain under existing policy, no partial candidate presented as completed
publication.cancel_after: committed directory wins; racing cancellation cannot undo actual success or delete it
publication.error: page/auth/disk/rename failure -> failed task, no claimed completed export; never touch old effective files or alter production
publication.receipt: actual export_id/query/selection/counts and2 real FileRefs; original request, scope, exporting kind and cloud_data_export output must match; no whole data body in get_task

design_cases.trigger: 百万原始导出期间继续写入
design_cases.expected: 从原F起点导出全部匹配行，后续写入不混入；只持当前页/缓冲，计数及两格式逐行对照

design_cases.trigger: 分钟聚合从头导出及空结果
design_cases.expected: null起始位置保留index0；空结果有CSV头和JSONL完整0行记录；不跳首行或只取当前页
请求先固定已选revision且全程相同；导出原始/数量/命令/等待行及未知原因，不跟随新head

design_cases.trigger: 改筛选/页大小/页面、设备权限变化或伪造pin
design_cases.expected: 导出原捕获语义筛选和实际设备集合；所有页授权；选择不匹配失败，不默默导另一集合或用pin授权

design_cases.trigger: 取消、下一页失败、磁盘或rename故障及提交竞态
design_cases.expected: 提交前无最终成功目录；旧有效数据不变；提交后真实成功胜出，生产状态不受影响
实际Host拒绝；不借H10目录选择、不收任意路径/URL；原请求查询精确关联H11

design_cases.trigger: CSV引号/逗号/换行/特殊开头字符串、精确数量和null
design_cases.expected: csv+JSON值格往返保持原typed值，微秒/数量不舍入，null不是0；JSONL全部原页/issue保留

design_cases.trigger: H10/H11同为exporting，大结果或回执选源不符
design_cases.expected: 共享handle不造oneOf歧义；按原operation/request和特定TaskOutput核对；不截断、错认报告或伪报文件完成
